t: On December 24, 1837 in the evening. - Réveillon.
On December 24, 1838 in the evening. - Réveillon.
d: The room on the first floor of the Caffè-Momus. - The billiard room on the right visible at the bottom. Entrance, for the spiral staircase in the corner from the room on the right. - It is evening: scene strongly illuminated. At the rise of the canvas, Schaunard, standing, with 'arms consert listen patiently to the lagoons of the Gaudenzio coffee maker.
The courtyard of the house inhabited by Musette on rue La Bruyère.
Rodolfo's attic, which is supposed to be the room you can see in Marcello's face in the previous act.
